data.title: 夜刀神十香 · 暖桌蜜柑的分享
data.description: 十香穿着柔软针织衫盘腿坐在暖桌前，认真剥开一颗蜜柑并把最甜的一瓣留到最后；她忽然把那一瓣递向镜头，紫瞳里写满“这次轮到你吃”。
data.location: Shido’s warm living room in winter
data.action: 暖桌前剥蜜柑把最甜一瓣递向镜头，眼神全是分享食物的期待
data.lighting: warm room light above the table and cool snowy window light
data.mood: 把普通晚餐变成精灵的分享仪式
data.promptProse: From the kotatsu, she offers the peeled mandarin segment toward the offscreen viewer with one hand cupped beneath the other, warm room light meeting the cool snowy window.
data.animaCaption: One hand cups beneath the other as she offers the peeled mandarin segment toward the viewer.
